name: When should I call a plumber for a drain smell?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for a drain smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber if you've tried common remedies like cleaning the drain, pouring hot water, or using baking soda and vinegar, and the drain smell persists. Persistent odors can indicate a deeper issue such as a significant clog that household products cannot clear, a dry or improperly vented P-trap, a damaged drain line, or even a sewer line problem. A professional plumber can accurately diagnose the source of the odor and provide an effective solution, preventing further plumbing complications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if persistent drain smells remain after home remedies, as it could signal a deeper clog, vent issue, or sewer line problem.
